original_test_intent: Verify a correctable xGMI3 fabric event for each required inter-socket direction or endpoint, with attributable source/destination evidence, preserved link service and deterministic recovery.
original_method: Enumerate xGMI links and map each tool link ID, local/remote socket, endpoint and errorlocation meaning from the approved tool/spec; capture BIOS/HDT/CPU/firmware/OS baseline; resolve whether the two commands target sockets, IOD/CCD blocks or directions; perform separately approved one-shot CE checkpoints; correlate command output with source/destination MCA/APEI or Windows WHEA and link counters/health; restore BIOS/HDT/injector state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps the xGMI fabric and tool fields, approves exact link/direction/endpoint commands, provisions HDT and the licensed injector, runs each CE checkpoint and restores the platform; the agent only gathers read-only evidence.
required_inputs: Dual/multi-socket CPU and xGMI topology including each tool link ID, width/speed and source/destination
Authoritative meaning of errorlocation 0/1 and proof of how Socket 1 versus Socket 0 is selected
AMD RAS tool/spec version/hash/license and linktraffic 1/errortype 0 semantics
Required direction/link coverage and per-endpoint CE MCA/APEI/WHEA plus counter oracle
Explicit timeout, allowed link effects and Linux-versus-Windows evidence paths
BIOS FFE deviation rationale, HDT procedure, aborts, console recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated supported multi-socket SUT with OOB console and recovery
Do not substitute the quoted link placeholder until topology and field semantics are approved
Inject one CE on one mapped direction/endpoint at a time and capture counter deltas
Abort on wrong socket/direction, UCE escalation, error storm, link width/speed degradation, reset, hang or lost console
No automatic retry; verify peer link health and restore BIOS/HDT/injector state
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool provenance and owner-supplied socket/link/direction/errorlocation map
Collect read-only topology, per-link counters, OS/BMC evidence and post-event peer health
Do not infer field semantics, alter BIOS/HDT, operate injector, choose target, repeat, recover automatically or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve Socket labels versus errorlocation semantics and approve exact substituted commands
Define required xGMI direction/endpoint coverage and corrected-event oracle
Approve package, timeout, abort, recovery and restoration
Review both checkpoint records and decide PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic xGMI log filtering cannot identify the commanded fabric direction or prove the peer remained healthy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Replace `xgmi lnk num` only with an owner-approved enumerated link and use package-documented endpoint/location fields; execute one direction at a time with source and peer counter evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both labeled socket checkpoints, errorlocation 0/1, linktraffic 1, errortype 0, BIOS controls and 20/10-minute estimate remain visible; their mapping and timeout are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a bidirectional socket/link map, run one approved correctable event per required direction and prove exact source/peer attribution with unchanged link service and restored state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds field semantics, direction map, peer evidence, per-link counter deltas, OS-specific oracle, bounded timeout and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Two commands do not prove two sockets if errorlocation selects IOD/CCD rather than the originating socket; a generic log cannot resolve direction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong xGMI link or endpoint may disrupt coherent fabric traffic, degrade width/speed or escalate beyond a correctable event.

project_override_considerations: If errorlocation 0/1 truly encode remote socket endpoints on this package, cite the approved revision. Otherwise retain Socket 1/0 coverage but replace the placeholder with the documented selector fields in an engineer-approved source correction.
expected_evidence: Approved two-socket topology and link/direction/errorlocation map
Tool/spec identity plus BIOS/HDT before/target/after state
Separate full command transcript for each required direction and CE status
Attributed source and peer MCA/APEI or WHEA plus xGMI counter/link-health evidence within timeout
No severity escalation or degradation, complete restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source labels errorlocation 0 as Socket 1 and 1 as Socket 0, while adjacent commands define the same fields as IOD and CCD locations. The executable retains a literal link placeholder, timeout is undefined and Windows is listed while Criteria requires dmesg. The intended inter-socket coverage cannot be proven without package semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Correctable xGMI3 and two socket-oriented checkpoints are clear. Engineering can provide the exact selector mapping and oracle, so static review completes and execution remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 40 Wistron-System RAS-00760-V003: approve the dual/multi-socket xGMI topology and exact substituted link number for each required direction; decide whether errorlocation 0/1 select Socket 1/0, IOD/CCD or another endpoint; provide AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and linktraffic=1/errortype=0 semantics, per-direction CE MCA/APEI/WHEA and link-counter oracle, timeout, BIOS FFE deviation, aborts, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Separates xGMI direction and endpoint attribution from a misleading numeric-location assumption, preventing two syntactically different commands from being counted as two-socket Coverage without proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: xGMI is a peer fabric, so a useful CE record needs both the selected physical link/direction and the observing source/remote endpoint. The same errorlocation values are described as IOD/CCD in adjacent cases, making the Socket 1/0 labels non-authoritative until the package specification resolves them. Quoted placeholder text is not executable and cannot be filled by prediction. Link counters and peer health matter because an accepted injection may still degrade coherent transport even when a generic corrected log appears.
